messages:
Noah (Design): Quick one — in the Vectors toolbar the Export and Copy buttons are getting visually deprioritized on medium windows. Users keep missing the export flow. Screenshot + short vid in thread.
Pal (Frontend): I can reproduce at 1280x720 and 1440x900. The toolbar wraps which hides the primary action under a more menu. Short-term: make the primary export a solid button and pin it to the right. Long-term: move format + include-vector options into the export modal.
Zoe (Product): Preference: keep export inline for small datasets but require a modal for anything >5k rows or when 'Include vectors' is checked. We must avoid accidental huge downloads. Also customers asked for NDJSON and a manifest/_meta.json.
Grace (ML): NDJSON + manifest is ideal. CSVs break when vectors contain commas or when quoting is inconsistent. We should also offer a 'compressed (.zip)' server-side option so we can provide a single archive with manifest + chosen file.
Noah (Design): Microcopy suggestions: toolbar button label should be 'Export dataset' (not just 'Export'). In modal: header 'Export dataset' and a short secondary line: 'Choose format and whether to include raw vectors (may be very large)'.
Omar (DevEx): Accessibility nits: 1) The toolbar export button needs aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded when the modal opens. 2) The modal should trap focus and shift focus to the primary CTA. 3) If we auto-recommend NDJSON, announce the recommendation to SR users (aria-live).
Pal (Frontend): Implementation plan: replace client-side textarea serialization with Blob streaming; call server to compute estimated compressed size before enabling the export button. If estimate > threshold show modal and default to NDJSON. We'll also add Content-Disposition with dataset id and row count.
Zoe (Product): UX decision: default format = CSV for exports <= 50MB, auto-recommend NDJSON for >50MB. Show a size badge next to format selector (e.g., ~42MB compressed). Include a checkbox: 'Include full vectors (required for offline rerank)'. This box unchecked by default.
Grace (ML): For safety, cap full-vector CSV to 15,000 rows for self-serve; allow NDJSON and zip for larger. For enterprise we'll add an override flag. Also add server-side streaming so we don't buffer whole payload in memory.
Noah (Design): Edge case: when table is condensed (compact rows) the per-row preview chevron should preserve keyboard affordances. Suggest adding a visible focus style and an accessible label like 'Expand preview for row 23'.
Omar (DevEx): Also add aria-live region for rerank scores column when users run a batch rerank so SR users get notified: 'Rank updated: item 12 moved +3 to position 5'. Keep it polite to avoid interrupting.
Pal (Frontend): I'll create PRs: 1) toolbar layout + pinned primary button, 2) export modal + Blob streaming + size estimate endpoint, 3) keyboard shortcuts (Shift+E = open export). Each PR will include unit tests for very long vector serialization and include NDJSON output checks.
Zoe (Product): Please include a small 'why NDJSON?' explainer in the modal linked to docs. And a one-click 'Include manifest (recommended)' option.
Grace (ML): I'll add server tests for estimated compressed size and streaming zip generation and a regression test for truncation (previous bug repro case attached).
Omar (DevEx): I'll run a keyboard + screen reader pass on the new modal and condensed-table behavior once the PRs are up.
bot-export: Ticket created: UI-5104 "Toolbar export discoverability + safe export modal (NDJSON, manifest, accessible)" — linked mocks and repro.
